title: Whole Grain Pasta with Cream Sauce, Meat and Vegetables (Ready‑to‑Heat)

content.title: About
content.content: This is a ready‑to‑eat dish made from whole‑grain pasta coated with a smooth cream sauce, enriched with quality meat and fresh vegetables. The pasta is pre‑cooked, so it only needs to be heated in a microwave or on the stove. The combination provides complex carbohydrates, protein, and vitamins for a balanced meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain pasta contains more fiber and micronutrients than regular white pasta.
The cream sauce is prepared with dairy and plant oils, giving a velvety texture without excessive fat.
The meat is typically chicken or turkey, offering a lean source of protein.
Vegetables such as carrots, broccoli, and bell pepper are added during cooking, retaining most of their vitamins and minerals.
The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days and frozen for up to 2 months.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta provides dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion and helps maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Good source of protein
items.content: The meat component supplies all essential amino acids needed for tissue repair and muscle maintenance.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Vegetables add vitamin C, vitamin A, potassium, and folate, supporting immunity and skin health.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: The cream sauce uses plant oils, reducing saturated fat compared with traditional dairy‑heavy sauces.

items.title: Sustained energy
items.content: The mix of complex carbs and protein offers lasting satiety and a steady energy release.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cream sauce contains milk; individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy allergy should choose an alternative.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ready‑made meals often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Heat safety
items.content: When reheating, ensure the internal temperature reaches at least 75 °C to eliminate possible bacteria.

items.title: Gluten presence
items.content: The pasta is wheat‑based and contains gluten, making it unsuitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the dish in the microwave (2–3 minutes) or on the stovetop, stirring to evenly warm the sauce. Serve immediately; optionally garnish with fresh herbs or grated cheese.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0–4 °C in the original packaging or an airtight container for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C for up to 2 months. Before reheating, check that the product has no off‑odors or discoloration.
